ModMetaData.name: Medic Warcasket
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Medic, a spacer-tier combat-medic warcasket for VFE Pirates, welded at the warcasket foundry like any other set.
The armor streams mechanites over a wounded squadmate and tends every wound on the spot. The shoulders hold adrenaline shots that keep the wounded on their feet a while longer, and the helmet lets the dressing treat disease and infection too. The pilot stays free to doctor.
Requires Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates. Supports CE, SOS2, and Vanilla Gravship Expanded.
